checks: Candidate verify.py passes authenticated A/B image pins, exact code/gap extraction, parent callsites, historical symbol hashes, fixtures and reproducible C-SKY objdump. Manifest and receipt pins agree.

Independent review confirms the two 30-byte bodies are separate A/B child spans at 0x1584 and 0x0FFC. Each forwards incoming R0 to its nested direct call, wraps status-2 in 32 bits, and only enters the MMIO path when the unsigned result is below 4; this is exactly status values 2 through 5.
Accepted paths read volatile words at 0xA0010058 then 0xA001005C in order. R0 is the first word's low bit; the later read is retained as a volatile access. Rejected paths return zero.
Both following zero halfwords are explicitly unowned BKPT gaps; historical symbol names/extents do not override the source-bound body extents.
limitations: Nested calls at A 0x10024940 and B 0x10003FB8 remain unresolved. MMIO effects, values, faults and hardware meaning are not established.
Image loading, route selection, physical visibility/aliasing and whole-payload closure remain unresolved. No canonical admission.
